description: This PHP script handles user authentication for the vtiger CRM system, including login validation, audit trail logging, session management, and redirection based on authentication success or failure.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: User model class used for authentication and user data management.

classes.name: LoginHistory
classes.description: Handles logging of user login history.

methods.name: load_user
methods.description: Loads user data based on provided password.

methods.name: is_authenticated
methods.description: Checks if the user credentials are valid.

methods.name: user_login
methods.description: Records user login details into login history.
